title: Rabbi Chanina son of Rabbi Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Bereshit Rabbah 95:3 he disagrees with Rabbi Chanina. He is mentioned in Tanchuma, Noach 14, and in Bereshit Rabbah 57:4 as Rabbi Chananya son of Rabbi Acha, together with Rabbi Chama. He is likewise mentioned in Esther Rabbah 3:6, but Vayikra Rabbah 3:6 reads Rabbi Chanina bar Abba.
